# halo-island

> Dynamic Island for React Native. One JSON template renders the in-app island (iOS, Android, web; pure JS via react-native-svg + Reanimated), the Android island over other apps, and the Android notification / Live Update. iOS Live Activities: not yet. Contract: src/spec.ts.

## Setup
- npx expo install halo-island react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-svg
- Optional: expo-haptics, expo-blur, expo-glass-effect, lottie-react-native
- Mount once at the root: <HaloIslandHost placement="auto|cutout|below" theme={} motion={} haptics dim />
- Android over-other-apps island: app.json plugins ["halo-island", { "overlay": true, "overlayReason": "...", "rive": false }] + requestPermissions({ overlay: true })

## Runtime API
- const t = island(template); const live = t.start(state, { id, overlay, system=true, inApp=true, expanded, duration })
- t.show(state)  // in-app toast, ends after 3s
- live.update(patch, { alert })  // merge; send only changed keys; alert pops it open
- live.end(); endAll(); live.on(action, (state) => {})
- useIsland(template, state | null, { id, alertOn: ['key'], onAction, onChange })  // island = view of React state; diffs, starts on non-null, ends on null/unmount. Prefer this when the screen shows the same data.
- useIslandAction(action, (islandId, state) => {})  // taps from every surface, even app killed
- onAction((islandId, action, state) => {})
- setState(id, patch)  // what inputs do; focus(id) brings an island to the front
- lookAt(x, y, { width, height })  // point every pet at a screen position
- capabilities() -> { liveActivities, liveUpdates, notifications, overlay }; openLiveUpdateSettings()
- asset(require('./x.png')) -> uri for image/rive
- registerIcons({ name: pathData24 }) adds icon names; registerAssets({ logo: require(..), 'lottie:x': require(..), 'rive:y': require(..) }) lets templates use names
- presets: ride timer media goal progress call score toast

## Template (plain JSON, all fields optional except compact)
{ compact: { leading?, trailing? }, minimal?, expanded?, screens?: { [name]: node }, lockScreen?, theme?, motion?, link? }
- Strings take {key} placeholders filled from state. Missing keys render empty.
- Num = number | '{key}'. Lists = array or comma string '{key}'.
- Expanded = compact row as header + expanded body below.

## Nodes (builder -> JSON type)
row(style?, ...kids) / column(style?, ...kids)  style: gap padding align(start|center|end|stretch|baseline) justify(start|center|end|between) background gradient[] radius border{width,color} width height opacity grow wrap
text(value, { size weight(regular|medium|semibold|bold|heavy) color mono font lines align })
icon(name, { size color }) | svg(pathData, { size width color viewBox stroke })
image(uri, { size width radius fit(cover|contain) glow })
ring(value0to1, { size thickness color track })
bar(value, { height color track }) | track(value, markerIconOrAsset?, { end flip markerSize height color track }) | steps(value, count, opts)
stack(style?, ...kids)  first child sizes, rest centered on it (value inside a ring)
bars(values, { active height gap color track animate }) | line(values, { height color fill thickness })
arc(value, { height thickness colors[] track glow marker markerSize }) | timeline(value, icons[], { size color track ink })
timer(toEpochMs, { countUp style })
button(action, label?, { icon color textColor tint confirm shape(pill|tile|circle) })
chips(bind, options[], { values[] color }) | slider(bind, { icon color track height }) | toggle(bind, label, { icon color })
pet(mood?, { size color cheeks })  moods: idle happy love sleepy surprised thinking wink sad focused
lottie(uri, { size width loop speed }) | rive(uri, { size width artboard stateMachine trigger inputs }) | spacer(size?)
fx(node, 'pulse'|'bounce'|'spin'|'wiggle'|'shimmer') | when('key' | '!key', node)

## Actions
- Custom: any string. Built-in: go:<screen>, back, close.
- Inputs write state[bind] (chips: option or values[i]; slider: 0-1; toggle: boolean) and emit change:<bind>.
- confirm: first tap shows the confirm text, second tap fires.

## Theme
{ background foreground secondary accent border radius glow gradient[] material('solid'|'glass') aura fonts{regular..heavy} light{} dark{} }
Colors: any RN color string. HaloIslandHost theme = base; template theme wins.

## Motion
'island' (default) | 'bouncy' | 'snappy' | 'smooth' | 'none' | { stiffness, damping }

## Truthiness (show, toggles)
Off: '' 0 false null undefined 'false' '0'. Everything else is on. '!key' inverts.

## Surface limits
- In-app: everything.
- Android overlay: no chips/slider/toggle, no screens (go:/back hidden), no row wrap, no glass (solid), pet blinks + morphs but doesn't track the finger.
- Android notification: text, first icon, first progress (ring/bar/steps), timer, up to 3 buttons (confirm and go:/back/close buttons omitted). Live Update chip on Android 16+.
- Template + state <= 4KB (screens are stripped before native).

## Rules of thumb
- Native look: compact = one glyph + one value. Expanded = title + grey line left, big value right, one visual, one button row. Semibold, accent only on the value and main button.
- Start from a preset; keep state flat; update only changed keys.
- Use when() for details that arrive later; '!key' for the "until then" state.
- Put confirm on paid or destructive buttons.
- Interactive inputs and screens are in-app only.
